'''Mathias and the Defias''' is a [[rogue]] [[quest]] available at level 20.  The quest is began by talking to [[Mathias Shaw]] in [[Stormwind]].

==Objective==
Travel to Westfall and find [[Amber Kearnen|Agent Kearnen]] for your debriefing.

Agent Kearnen is well hidden just to the north of the defias tower and under a small tree.

==Description==
Not a moment too soon, <name>. [[SI:7]] reconnaissance is reporting unusually heavy Defias activity in [[Westfall]].

It would seem that the Defias have taken over an abandoned [[Mortwake's Tower|Alliance watch tower]] southeast of [[Sentinel Hill]] and are using it as a base of operations to smuggle in goods from the [[Redridge]] supply route.

Get to Westfall and contact Agent Kearnen for your debriefing. You will find her hidden near the tower.

...and <name>, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
*390 [[XP]]

==Completion==
Mathias finally sent another agent to back me up, eh? Well I hope he's ready to hear some bad news.
